findings.text: Arch layer claims ownership of modify_prot_start_ptes and also of modify_prot_commit_ptes through self referential definitions, indicating arch specific overrides. Fragments show presence only, not operational steps.

Contiguous entry optimization applies only to user address spaces. The helper reports false for the initial address space and for EFI address spaces, and callers bypass folding, unfolding and contiguous marking otherwise, because dynamic changes could fault kernel mappings while user faults serialize on the page table lock.

Inline fold gate acts only at the last virtual slot of a contiguous block and then requires the physical number to also sit at the block tail with valid set plus contiguous and special clear before delegating to the slow fold routine. This placement exploits low to high update order as the likely final modification.

Slow fold path rejects kernel contexts, recovers the folio behind the given entry, and proceeds only when one folio fully spans the aligned block. It then verifies every member as valid with sequential physical numbers and equal protection ignoring accessed and dirty, and finally installs a contiguous marked entry while preserving the logical OR of those two flags across members.

Conversion routine aligns address and pointer down to block start, normalizes the supplied entry to block base, clears all members while collecting dirty and young into the replacement, conditionally flushes the range unless large block maintenance level three is available, and repaints the whole block with the unified entry.

Unfold gate tests for valid plus contiguous set and slow path additionally requires user context before clearing contiguity and reusing conversion to expand the block into individual entries with preserved flags.

Batch hint returns one for entries lacking valid contiguous marking and otherwise returns the count of slots remaining to the end of the aligned block derived from pointer offset, guiding batch operations.

Locked read returns the raw entry when valid contiguous is absent and otherwise scans the aligned block to fold dirty and young from any member into the returned value, relying on the page table lock to prevent concurrent unfold or modification during the scan.

Lockless read returns immediately when the target lacks valid contiguous marking. Otherwise it repeatedly snapshots the aligned block and restarts whenever any member fails valid contiguous, physical sequentiality or protection equality ignoring accessed and dirty, aggregating those two flags only from a verified consistent snapshot to tolerate races with unfold or refold.

Set interface forces noncontiguous on the incoming value. For a single entry it unfolds any existing contiguous cover before storing then tries to refold, while for multiple entries it assumes not present initials and delegates to a splitter that marks only fully aligned pieces contiguous and bypasses the optimization for kernel spaces.

Legacy single store lacking address space and address cannot perform unfolding or TLB work, so it warns once if overwriting a valid contiguous entry and always stores a noncontiguous value. Core code is expected never to use it.

Clear and get clear helpers unfold any covering contiguous entry before operating for single entries. For ranges they unfold only edge blocks that are misaligned or shorter than a full block, leaving fully covered interior blocks to be cleared as a whole without prior expansion.

Get and clear for one entry unfolds first then performs the archival clear, while the try set operation attempts an atomic compare exchange from empty to the new value and issues barriers directly so ordering holds even under lazy mode that would otherwise defer them.

Young management uses a fast single noncontiguous path and otherwise expands the affected interval to cover any overlapping contiguous blocks, clearing young across the expansion and reporting whether any member was young. The flush variant additionally issues a range TLB flush without trailing synchronization when young was observed, relying on per folio tracking to justify clearing the whole block.

Kernel range helper flushes exactly one page before setting, and conversion omits its intermediate range flush when large block maintenance level three is supported, relying on the later per page flush to evict both stale single and new contiguous cached translations without amalgamation of permissions.

Pointer alignment helper rounds a table pointer down to its containing contiguous block start and range expander extends a caller supplied interval outward to block boundaries whenever either edge currently carries contiguity, returning the adjusted pointer for full block scans.

Contiguous block geometry is parameterized by symbolic count, byte size and mask constants that govern masking of indices, alignment of addresses and pointers, and gating of contiguous marking. Fragments use them consistently but do not reveal numeric values.
